Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid, Soft brush
Suitable lifting device, Feeler gauge
Hammer, Torque wrench, 
 Manual puller
Dial indicator.
K&N air filter cleaner
K&N air filter oil
Work to be 
Carried out
Run Engine ( per NFPA20 Specification ).
Make general inspection for the engine.
Check all anchor bolts and support steel fasteners 
 bolts and tighten if necessary, Fuel tank and lubricating oil.
Check cooling system, exhaust system, operating 
 gauges, jacket water heater & coolant hose inspection.
Check fuel lines.
Clean battery.
Check Air Cleaner- Dray Type ( -03AN & -04AN ).
Check Drive belts condition.
Check Speed control.
Check Exhaust System.
Check Manual Contractors.
Check Governor Run-stop Mechanism.
